arguments.sql:
WITH recent AS (
    SELECT player_api_id, defensive_work_rate,
           RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY player_api_id ORDER BY date DESC) AS recency
    FROM main.Player_Attributes
), flags AS (
    SELECT player_api_id, COUNT(*) AS records,
           COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN defensive_work_rate IN ('low', 'high') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS eligibility_values
    FROM recent WHERE recency = 1 GROUP BY player_api_id
)
SELECT SUM(records > 1) AS tied_players, SUM(eligibility_values > 1) AS conflicting_players,
       (SELECT COUNT(*) - COUNT(DISTINCT player_api_id) FROM main.Player) AS duplicate_or_null_keys,
       (SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT typeof(height)) FROM main.Player) AS height_types,
       (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM main.Player_Attributes WHERE date IS NULL OR date <> datetime(date) OR datetime(date) IS NULL) AS nonstandard_dates
FROM flags

arguments.sql:
WITH recent AS (
    SELECT a.*, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY a.player_api_id ORDER BY a.date DESC) AS recency
    FROM main.Player_Attributes AS a
), flags AS (
    SELECT player_api_id,
           MIN(CASE WHEN defensive_work_rate IN ('low', 'high') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS certain,
           MAX(CASE WHEN defensive_work_rate IN ('low', 'high') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS possible
    FROM recent WHERE recency = 1 GROUP BY player_api_id
)
SELECT AVG(CASE WHEN f.certain = 1 THEN p.height END) AS excluding_tie,
       AVG(CASE WHEN f.possible = 1 THEN p.height END) AS including_tie,
       (SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(r.id || '/' || COALESCE(r.defensive_work_rate, 'NULL') || '/' || r.player_fifa_api_id || '/' || p2.player_fifa_api_id)
        FROM recent AS r JOIN flags AS f2 USING (player_api_id) JOIN main.Player AS p2 USING (player_api_id)
        WHERE r.recency = 1 AND f2.certain <> f2.possible) AS conflicting_records
FROM main.Player AS p JOIN flags AS f USING (player_api_id)

WITH ranked_ratings AS (
    SELECT player_api_id, defensive_work_rate,
           RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY player_api_id ORDER BY date DESC) AS recency
    FROM main.Player_Attributes
)
SELECT ROUND(AVG(p.height), 2) AS average_height_cm
FROM main.Player AS p
WHERE p.player_api_id IN (
    SELECT player_api_id
    FROM ranked_ratings
    WHERE recency = 1 AND defensive_work_rate IN ('low', 'high')
)
LIMIT 1
